description: Adversarial review Lows and M9: (L2) fork manifest gaps: upstream-owned files edited with no carried entry (Makefile, setup.py, README.md, package-test.yml) and new files with no entry (tests/test_downstream_{contract,distribution,refresh}.py, two workflows); (L3) tracker finish summaries must carry evidence in context and acceptance criteria met or deviations recorded; (L4) QuestDB comma-join rewrite attaches unqualified equalities to the first comma join (Q5 plan/timing may move); (L5) ENGINE-GAPS.md:173 netezza description stale, QuestDB CI image pinned by tag not digest (ci.yml:571), checker uses default QuestDB credentials; (L7) BigQuery window NULLS fix limited to FIRST_VALUE/LAST_VALUE/NTH_VALUE (aggregate windows with default RANGE frame may hit the same rejection), DECIMAL(38) one-parameter becomes NUMERIC(38) (BigQuery rejects), Spark layout format overrides a statement's own USING contrary to the README; (L8) netezza lone JULIANDAY(x) 2458850 vs SQLite 2458849.5, timestamp day differences differ between engines; (M9) none of the 13 carried patches has been offered upstream and the manifest has no upstream-state field; the SQLite division change alters transpile() for every caller including SQLite->SQLite (consider an opt-in exact_division rewrite like safe_division instead of generator behavior). Triage each: fix, document with evidence, or decline with a reason.
